inputs_summary.input_claim:

Sonrada billboardlara ''Dünya da en çok metro yapılan şehir'' diye slogan asmıştı.

reading.summary_en: An aerial video shot shows a large deep concrete construction pit next to an urban road, where a dump truck tilts its bed to drop material inside the pit while traffic passes by on the street above.
